reason: Constructor validation makes the supplied list available immediately, but it also consumes a one-shot vocabulary before fit can validate it again and moves invalid-vocabulary errors to construction, neither of which the recorded tests cover.
The empty-list check suppresses the warning, but calling len on a scalar number raises TypeError, consistent with the recorded failure of test_convert_one_number.
Clearing the exception for every xfail marker can turn a real failure into a pass even when the marker condition is false, and the existing Boolean xfail test fails.
The change preserves the example comment, but it expands scientific values such as 1E-10 to 1.0E-10, which can truncate a previously fitting comment on a long keyword, a case the recorded tests miss.
